plan.h: Round 2: 12 notes read 2026-11-18. The big one: Karen throws her phone away ON PURPOSE, as a protest
items: The night before becomes the turning point: drunk at the river, Karen swears to make the complaint of the century, tells Sean to fuck off, and throws her phone in. That's why she's in a phone box next morning (no 'why didn't she just buy a new phone' worry).

Next morning Susan reminds her of the pact; a quick flashback to the river; Karen rolls her sleeves up at the real phone box. The 'People like Susan lie in bed doing nothing' speech goes. The film shows 'be proactive', it doesn't say it.

plan.h: Words (new narration in the Algenib voice; drafts, by Claude, yours to change)
items: 0:38 replaces 'She smugly turns the laptop around...': "Stunned, Karen hands the laptop back to her boss. A.I. Sean fires him too." Then the boss's reaction, then the defenestrate line as it is.
0:50 drop 'one bar tab': "Next stop: getting fucked up with Susan. A.I. Sean sacked her this morning too. Two redundancies."

1:02 at the river, two short spoken lines (muted clips, dubbed the way this film does it): KAREN (Gacrux): "Tomorrow I'm making the complaint of the century. You hear that, Sean? Fuck you, Sean. Fuck this technology." [phone goes in] SUSAN (Kore): "Karen, you mad lad."

1:26 replaces the Susan-explains / bar-tab / 'She doesn't' lines: "Susan reminds her. Last night she threw her phone in the river, and swore to make the biggest complaint the world has ever seen." [flashback: Karen at the river, her line again]
1:38 replaces the whole 'People like Susan lie in bed...' speech: "So Karen rolls her sleeves up, and starts feeding the pay phone."

Edit only: fix the 2-frame flicker at 1:02 (the throw clip starts on two frames of a different wide shot; trim them). Cut the Susan-asleep shot (1:06, agreed round 1). Swap the night phone box at 1:39 for the canonical daytime box (new clip 12), and keep that box the whole way.

New shots in Flow (stills first, you approve, then clips): 1) Karen in a coffee shop, finger pointed at a barista (replaces 0:09). 2) The laptop: Sean firing the boss (a screen, no face; the words go on in post). 3) The boss reacting. 4) Karen at the river railing, phone held up, shouting at it (for the protest line). The throw itself (new clip 8) we keep: it already looks deliberate, which is now right.
Flashback: re-use the river shots with a flashback treatment in post (no new clip needed).
Go on the words above as drafted, or send them through a dialogue-options round (ten writers, three drafts per line, you pick on a page) first.
Go on the four new Flow shots (stills are free; clips use video credits).
Premiere: I build all this as a new sequence 'karen-1-story-r2' next to Jack's 'Karen v4' (his cut is never touched). OK?
